[Trait] DEFENDER OF THE INNOCENT Wonder Woman starts the game with 3 Fortified tokens. Each time Wonder Woman rolls for the [ta:kingdom_come] or [ta:wonder_woman_ally], give her X Fortified tokens where X is the result of her roll. // FREE: Remove any number of Fortified tokens to modify defense +X until your next turn where X is the number of Fortified tokens removed.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT Powers: Phasing Teleport Phasing/Teleport with a Speed value of 10. FREE: If this character is adjacent to an object, a printed wall or a printed square of blocking terrain, place them in another square within 6 squares and line of fire that is adjacent to an object, printed wall or printed square of blocking terrain.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT Powers: Incapacitate Incapacitate, Range of 4. FREE: Make an attack using Incapacitate and must give action tokens. If the equipped character has [ta:wonder_woman_ally], all other characters adjacent to an original target also become targets. FREE: If the equipped character is named Wonder Woman, remove this object from the game and don't score it. If you do, equip that Wonder Woman with any other Wonder Woman Equipment from outside the game.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: [Defense] I GOT YOU! Adjacent friendly characters have Energy Shield/Deflection.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT Powers: Blades Claws Fangs Blades/Claws/Fangs. If the equipped character has [ta:wonder_woman_ally], their attack rolls of 10-11 are critical hits. FREE: If the equipped character is named Wonder Woman, remove this object from the game and don't score it. If you do, equip that Wonder Woman with any other Wonder Woman Equipment from outside the game.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT This character has [ta:wonder_woman_ally]. If this character has the [ta:wonder_woman_ally] printed on its base, Super Senses it can use gains Protected: Outwit. FREE: If the equipped character is named Wonder Woman, remove this object from the game and don't score it. If you do, equip that Wonder Woman with any other Wonder Woman Equipment from outside the game.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT Powers: Invulnerability [cs:wing], Invulnerability. If the equipped character has [ta:wonder_woman_ally] and is on their starting click, they take a maximum of 1 damage from attacks. FREE: If the equipped character is named Wonder Woman, remove this object from the game and don't score it. If you do, equip that Wonder Woman with any other Wonder Woman Equipment from outside the game.

property.value: [Trait] STOP AND THINK IT OVER Opposing characters within 2 squares can't use Improved Movement.
